milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the blue carpet L-shape (centered around ~2, 0, 2.5) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 is generous since the carpet is only ~3 blocks from spawn, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining purple_wool drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player does NOT start with purple_wool in their inventory, so having at least 1 proves they mined it from the scene.

Uses inventory_has because crafting light_gray_carpet (from 2 light_gray_wool placed horizontally) results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with light_gray_wool but NOT light_gray_carpet, so having at least 1 light_gray_carpet proves they completed the craft.
